profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the Computer Software industry. Skilled in C++,  ReactJs, Javascript, Typescript, HTML, CSS, Java, Spring Boot.

Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) focused in Computer Science from Wentworth Institute of Technology.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Software engineer maintaining and developing software for AN/TPY2 system.
positions.insights: Skills: Ada Lang · C++ · Formal Qualified Testing

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Full-stack software engineer developing modern software for Kessel Run project supporting the U.S Air Force.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop and maintain online inference services that improves Playstation Store users' experience by personalizing their purchase and gameplay experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Scala · Akka · Seldon · Machine Learning · Databrick · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python · AWS · Kubernetes · Helm Charts

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Joined in order to modernize their outdated monolith backend server to scale with microservices.
• Contribute to back-end development using Java, Spring Boot, Looker.
• Work with AWS services (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, etc...).
• Follow Agile methodologies.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed modern Web Applications using React, Typescript, Mobx State Tree, Java Spring Boot, MySql.
• Developed GIS application supporting airspace defense by utilizing OpenLayers.
• Maintained team CI/CD pipeline using Concourse, Nexus, Fortify, SonarQube, Docker.
• Deployd, debugged and maintained web application instances on Pivotal Cloud Foundry.
• Proactively upheld best practices and promote continuous learning/teaching among co-workers.
• Practiced Pair-Programming, Test-Driven Development, Extreme programming daily.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · CSS · Java · Spring Boot · Extreme Programming · Microservices · Git · React.js · TypeScript

positions.title: AR Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Worked as an AR (Augmented Reality) Developer at EChO - Eradicate Childhood Obesity Foundation.
• Develop EChO's mobile application known as SugAR Poke for both Android and iOS platforms using Unity(C#), Vuforia and Xcode.
• Work collaboratively with other team members. 
• Discussed new ideas and features for the app with other developers and non-developer team members.
• Since EChO is a startup, I had a chance to learn how a 501(c)(3) charity foundation works and collaborate with other communities around The Greater Boston Area to help improve public health within these communities.

company.name: EChO - Eradicate Childhood Obesity Foundation, Inc.

positions.title: Frontend Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Worked as a front-end web developer for ASA’s product  Saltmoney (https://www.saltmoney.org).
• Developed UI for the website rebranding/redesign (HTML, Sass, Dust.js, jQuery, HighChart.js).
• Communicated and discussed with QA team and back-ended team about current development.
• Reviewed and commented on coworkers’ code, UI design.
• Followed Agile methodologies (daily stand-up, Stories, Sprint).

positions.title: Customer Service Staff
positions.description: Provides quality customer service by answering customers' questions and guided them through the process of getting auto insurance both directly and through the phone.

projects.title: ARchitecture
projects.description: ARchitecture is an iOS mobile application that utilizes ARKit development platform to create augmented reality experience by displaying architectural 3D models into the real world.

projects.title: NoSpoof
projects.description: Python scripts (one that runs on Mac and one that runs on Window) that would detect and prevent Man in the Middle Attack. The scripts will listen to selected network interface and detects malicious ARSpoof attacks. Once detect, the script will disconnect device from the network.
